We examine three different areas covering techniques for spin measurement, photon preparation and error correction. The first research chapter presents a robust spin-measurement procedure, using an amplification approach: the state of the spin is propagated over a two-dimensional array to a point where it can be measured using standard macroscopic state mea- surement techniques.
